Halloumi label per 100g 306 kcal, 21.8g protein, 5.3g carbs, 22.1g fat; 45g = 138 kcal, 9.8g protein. Salad 190g estimated 55 kcal, 2g protein, 11g carbs, 1g fat, no substantial dressing/oil assumed.
